name: Justice Consumer Law
verdict: Meta's "Leads - August Re-Launch" drove all 99 leads at a $18.34 CPL across 28 days, but spend dropped 19.61% and leads fell 13.64% week-over-week, likely reflecting budget pacing or audience fatigue. GBP is a bright spot, up 21.74% in 7-day actions with 57 calls and 139 web clicks, though CRM reconciliation shows 99 Meta-reported leads versus only 81 GHL contacts with 0 opportunities created, which remain unreconciled.

performance.verdict: CPL is healthy but a 0-opportunity pipeline means no lead is converting to case.

findings.text: GHL shows 0 opportunities created from 81 contacts and 99 Meta leads — intake is not converting leads to pipeline at all.
⛔ Extension with Marwan unsigned since 2026-08-31 — engagement is month-to-month lapsed, gating the next 3-month contract.
⛔ SMS automation and Zoho Voice access both overdue since 2026-08-31 — contact-rate bottleneck remains unaddressed without these tools.
3-day lead signal (Sep 25–27: 6, 2, 7 leads) vs prior 3 days (Sep 22–24: 9, 5, 2) is flat-to-soft; spend also dipped from $79 to $59–$97 range with no directional collapse.
28-day CPL of $18.34 is well inside the $19–45/wk historical range — spend efficiency is healthy; the 7d CPL improvement of -6.92% confirms no fatigue signal yet.

suggestions.text: Fix GHL intake: 99 Meta leads, 0 opportunities created — audit contact-to-opp workflow this week.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 99 Meta-reported leads and 81 contacts but 0 opportunities created across the full 28-day window — the intake workflow is not converting contacts to pipeline. Audit the GHL contact-to-opportunity automation (stage triggers, Andrew's Zoho handoff) and identify where leads are dropping. Success is confirmed when at least 1 opportunity is created per 3 new contacts within 7 days. Resolve by 2026-10-05.

suggestions.text: Escalate Zoho Voice access and SMS automation to Nacer — both overdue 28+ days, blocking contact-rate improvement.
suggestions.monday_update: Both Zoho Voice access and SMS automation were due 2026-08-31 and remain undelivered — 28+ days overdue. The SOW identifies contact rate as the primary bottleneck to Marwan's signed-case goal, and neither tool is live. Nacer to chase Joy/Andrew for Zoho Voice credentials and confirm SMS sequences are deployed in GHL. Success check: SMS automation live and Zoho Voice confirmed active by 2026-10-05.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta lead volume over next 3 days; if daily leads fall below 3 for 3 consecutive days, escalate creative refresh.
suggestions.monday_update: The 3-day lead signal (6, 2, 7) is flat against the prior window (9, 5, 2) and CPL at $18.34 remains healthy — no confirmed fatigue yet. Monitor daily lead count through 2026-10-01; if leads drop below 3/day for 3 straight days, flag for creative refresh on the Marwan/Rocco video batch (shoot owed since June). No budget change this cycle.
